scope: Complete raw byte swaps and live file endian exchange/get

native.closure: Whole raw word/dword byte-reversal and live endian exchange/get bodies; unaligned pointers andalias into state DWORD, zeroports

semantics: Swap16/32 snapshot the original bytes then reverse their order and preserve EAX input pointer. Unaligned source and aliases into global endian DWORD preserve exact writes.

Exchange performs a plain DWORD load/store at91EEA0 and returns previous value; it is not an atomic XCHG. Get returns current value unchanged. All nonzero values are retained as opaque DWORDs for existing typed-writer reversal.
limitations: Prepared readable/writable2/4-byte targets, disjoint from original private stack. CPU flags/register artifacts except projected EAX outside portable state.
386 core inputs plus harness compiled library only; managed replay UNEXECUTED. All four exact raw entries unregistered; zero address credit.
